shared_elements: low-relief carving with figures shown in strict profile
human arms/hands and legs of a striding figure
densely patterned surface texture indicating hair, fleece or feathers
partial human figure interacting with animal
raised outline with incised interior detail
justification: Both are low-relief scenes in strict profile with striding figures, human hands and arms rendered with the same muscular convention, and dense repetitive incised texture used for fleece in A and feathers/wings in B, plus a hand raised or laid toward an animal/other element. The subject matter differs substantially, however: A shows a pair of naturalistic horned rams led by a human, while B shows a single bird-headed winged anthropomorphic figure with a bucket beside a field of stylised rosette-plants under a band of writing.
